parameters.query: select id from companies where in_eval_set order by id;

with r as (select $1::jsonb as j),
b as (
  insert into briefs (company_id, model, run_label, is_real_signal, hiring_focus,
                      team_context, evidence, personalization_line, confidence, raw_response)
  select (j->>'company_id')::bigint, j->>'model', j->>'run_label',
         (j->>'is_real_signal')::boolean, j->>'hiring_focus', j->>'team_context',
         j->>'evidence', j->>'personalization_line', (j->>'confidence')::numeric,
         j->'raw_response'
  from r where (j->>'has_brief')::boolean
  returning id
)
insert into llm_calls (company_id, brief_id, model, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, status)
select (j->>'company_id')::bigint, (select id from b), j->>'model',
       (j->>'prompt_tokens')::int, (j->>'completion_tokens')::int, j->>'status'
from r;
